answer.text:

- [2010.14293](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.14293): Search for squarks and gluinos in final states with jets and missing transverse momentum using 139 fb^-1 of √s = 13 TeV pp collision data with the ATLAS detector
- [2107.12553](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.12553): Search for chargino-neutralino production in events with Higgs and W bosons using 137 fb^-1 of proton-proton collisions at √s=13 TeV
- [2205.05120](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.05120): Constraints on anomalous Higgs boson couplings to vector bosons and fermions from the production of Higgs bosons using the final state
- [2209.07327](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.07327): Search for pair production of vector-like quarks in leptonic final states in proton-proton collisions at √s=13 TeV

question: Which analyses estimate the background Nonprompt lepton (reducible) background from Z+jets and ttbar?

answer.text:
The following analyses estimate the background Nonprompt lepton (reducible) background from Z+jets and ttbar:

- **2106.01676**: Search for chargino–neutralino pair production in final states with three leptons and missing transverse momentum in \( \sqrt{s}=13 \) TeV \( pp \) collisions with the ATLAS detector.
- **2109.13808**: ggF + 2 jets CP-sensitive analysis of the effective Higgs-gluon coupling.
- **2109.13808**: VBF HVV polarisation-coupling analysis (a_L, a_T / kappa_VV, epsilon_VV).
- **2112.03161**: Search for heavy resonances decaying to a pair of Lorentz-boosted Higgs bosons in final states with leptons and a bottom quark pair at \( \sqrt{s}=13 \) TeV.
- **2209.07327**: Search for pair production of vector-like quarks in leptonic final states in proton-proton collisions at \( \sqrt{s}=13 \) TeV.
- **2211.08028**: Search for supersymmetry in final states with missing transverse momentum and three or more \( b \)-jets in 139 fb\(^{-1}\) of proton–proton collisions at \( \sqrt{s}=13 \) TeV with the ATLAS detector.
- **2503.19420**: Measurements of the production cross-sections of a Higgs boson in association with a vector boson and decaying into \( WW^{\ast} \) with the ATLAS detector at \( \sqrt{s}=13 \) TeV.

These analyses use both Z+jets and ttbar samples in their background estimation.

- General search for supersymmetric particles in scenarios with compressed mass spectra using proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13\,\text{Te\hskip-0.80002ptV}$ (2508.13900)
- Improved results on Higgs boson pair production in the 4 $\mathup{{{b}}}$ final state (2604.27044)

- Inclusive nonresonant multilepton probes of new phenomena at $\sqrt{s}=13\,\text{Te\hskip-0.80002ptV}$ (2202.08676)
- Measurement of the total and differential cross-sections of $t\bar{t}W$ production in $pp$ collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV with the ATLAS detector (2401.05299)
- Measurements of $WH$ and $ZH$ production in the $H\rightarrow b\bar{b}$ decay channel in $pp$ collisions at $13\,\text{Te\kern-1.00006ptV}$ with the ATLAS detector (2007.02873)
- Search for electroweak production of charginos and neutralinos in proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13\,\text{Te\hskip-0.80002ptV}$ (2106.14246)
- Search for squarks and gluinos in final states with jets and missing transverse momentum using 139 fb -1 of $\sqrt{s}$ =13 TeV $pp$ collision data with the ATLAS detector (2010.14293)
- Search for supersymmetry in final states with missing transverse momentum and three or more $b$ -jets in 139 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV with the ATLAS detector (2211.08028)
- Search for top squarks in events with a Higgs or $Z$ boson using 139 fb -1 of $pp$ collision data at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV with the ATLAS detector (2006.05880)
- Searches for lepton-flavour-violating decays of the Higgs boson into $e\tau$ and $\mu\tau$ in $\sqrt{s}=13$  TeV $pp$ collisions with the ATLAS detector (2302.05225)
